title: Survey + label C-side hardcoded native-profile address vectors
description: Slice of q6ko discovered during recon: python/tests/test_vectors.py docstring cites 'Zephyr C hardcoded checks' for yggdrasil-derivation.json vectors. Survey lichen/tests/pubkey_to_iid/main.c and any other C consumer (link_crypto, ping_l2, ipv6_addr) for hardcoded rejected-SHA-512-native-profile address/IID vectors; label them quarantined-pending-upstream-migration (comment referencing spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing + test/vectors/legacy/) or repoint them at the quarantine files. Do NOT migrate the C derivation itself (upstream migration is separate track). Verify with the host CMake test path for the touched test.
